summary: Frontend-only regression for header restructure, service/location pages, legal page with markdown tabs, footer explore (hash-nav) & footer legal/locations, service CTA session-storage prefill, and mobile menu. All acceptance criteria pass; 0 console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: Contact.jsx reads sessionStorage rk_service only inside useState lazy init — value never clears after prefill; if user navigates away and back on the same tab, stale service persists. Consider removing the key after read.
Landing.jsx effect deletes rk_scroll_to but never clears rk_service — minor lifecycle leak of session state.

Location slugs mix case (bridal-makeup-Bangalore) and typos (best-bridal-makup-artist, karnatka) intentionally per SEO spec; consider React Router case-sensitive routing compatibility across proxies (works today via preview).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 covered: new header (7 items, Look Lab/Try-On/Pricing/Testimonials removed), services dropdown w/ 7 links, all 7 service + 4 location pages (title/body/bio/faq/location-links), /about-us, /makeup-course-training-bangalore (bullets), /personal-shopping, /blog (3 cards), /legal (4 legal-section-* with rendered h3+ul markdown, tab click activates pink bg #E62E6B and scrolls target into view), footer legal/location/explore hash nav (cross-page /pricing & /testimonials scroll works, tested from /bridal-makeup-artist-bangalore), footer-service-fashion-makeup nav, CTA chain bridal & party -> contact-service-select values 'Bridal'/'Party' both verified, regression on / (all landing sections present, nav-book scroll works, cross-page nav-book from /blog works), mobile 390x844 no horizontal overflow, mobile menu opens with 6 main links + 7 service grid + closes on navigation. Zero console errors.
